title: Koine provider architecture
intro: The workflow extension is designed and pending implementation; the baseline views describe the served desktop contract. All providers share one resident Koine process and its native limits. Graphs begin at the node labelled Start here; sequences read from their first message. On narrow screens use native size and pan, the SVG export, or the reflowable spec.

discussion.title: URL result and next long-path workaround
discussion.status: Long-path requirement absolute · finite namespace diagnostic authorized
discussion.summary: Both public URL creation patterns passed acquisition, local identity/marker reads and original-byte conversion at 900/1,023 bytes, but failed acquisition at 1,024/1,500. The initial instrument stop, sole correction and expressly authorized replacement remain separate. Long consumers and later action stages were not reached. Antony authorized the exact finite bare native object namespace diagnostic: XNU source/tests supply a same-object local opening lead, while filename loss, changed submission spelling, lasting support and Zed normalization remain explicit limits. A filename-preserving suffix variant was removed after source review found its fixed PATH_MAX append. One guest/collection, four file/directory subjects, at most twelve default/Zed/Finder requests and a 45-minute cap will test real receivers in a fresh prototype session, with a verified fresh receiver baseline for each request. Native execution is unrun; no production spelling/support exception, complete route or workflow loss is adopted. The completed source/charter handoff leaves one prototype and returned design live. Native facts, long registration/selection/constrained launch, executable receipt, final review and independent action/search acceptance remain required.

updatedDiagrams.summary: Consumes the completed URL failures, marks long-path support absolute, and records authorization for the bounded bare-object namespace/receiver diagnostic while retaining its production gaps.

groups.title: Application and file search · designed
groups.description: Resolver bounds and name-preserving locations remain selected. Review found missing pre-open foreign-mount/symlink witness rules and incomplete replay/metadata phases; current/prefix size scopes need independent-proof repair. Two producer/review chains precede classification and its review, then whole-resource review/planning. Long-result actions require launch/open design/review: the search ceiling is no actionability guarantee. No call set, account, domain, consent or accepted workflow coverage changes; native/binary/no-dialog/useful outcomes and the operator omissions decision remain pending.

groups.title: Launch and open · designed, not yet served
groups.description: Installed application selection, web/document opening and Finder reveal. Native acknowledgment does not certify rendered contents or foreground state; document handlers can execute content or follow redirects.

groups.title: First-party selection · designed, not yet served
groups.description: One startup choice per shipped identity, with visible refusals and no retry after selection. The Machine spec holds the complete decision table and acceptance cases.

groups.title: Workflow extension · designed, not yet served
groups.description: Authority ownership, target capture and mixed-effect dispatch. The spec owns the detailed allocation and acceptance trace.

groups.title: Overview
groups.description: Runtime ownership and source-package dependencies are separate views.

groups.title: Desktop GraphQL contract
groups.description: Query, derive choices, choose, then authorize and act.

diagrams.title: Separate local access, opener delivery and receiver access
diagrams.caption: Source/charter view, not native action acceptance. k149 passes local acquisition/reading/original bytes at 900/1,023 and fails acquisition at 1,024/1,500; long consumers and subsequent stages were not reached. Private descriptor/name resolution keeps public pathname inputs. The bare volfs object spelling is covered by pinned upstream local-open tests, not an opener/receiver promise; the filename-preserving suffix variant still hits MAXPATHLEN and is excluded. Antony authorized only the exact finite diagnostic of changed external spelling, filename loss and compatibility-only support. Zed may normalize back to a long whole path. Receiver observations need per-request freshness. Native execution is unrun and no production exception or complete route is adopted. Every original working case, native fact/selection/receipt contract, controls, independent action/search and 1.0.0/1.0.1/1.1.0 acceptance, final review and planning duty remains live.

diagrams.title: Observe applicable events and independent serviceability
diagrams.caption: Evidence flow, not implementation or native acceptance. Owned events and native-call envelopes, passive pre-suppression NIO error/scheduling hooks and independent clients/store/actions have separate attribution. Fixed storage, site counters, owner generations and open-at-cut/loss controls reject incomplete evidence. Deliberate transient/dropped-event/overflow/suppressed-error and real-exhaustion controls must fail the serviceability observation they induce; they never pass search acceptance. Controlled saturation and unheld native runs retain distinct evidence labels. Matched no-search references cannot waive independent resource error or accept backoff, even after eventual success. A complete passing finite subject supports only empirical outcomes under the selected boundary; opaque acquisitions/peaks/internal health remain unproved. All runtime controls, exact native prompt/useful-launch/home and compatibility acceptance remain pending.

diagrams.title: Connect native allocation to specified serviceability subjects
diagrams.caption: Keeps k119 allocation constraints; replay/metadata composition and classification need repair before whole-resource review. Allocation ownership/subject construction design, not native acceptance; selected long-path classification remains unresolved; pre-open witness and replay/size-phase repairs require producer reviews. Native metadata/registration are reported observations under the delegated fact boundary; undetected internal failure or stale state can still mislead. Copied values/array iteration stay bounded in existing scratch/wait while returned platform objects remain opaque allocations. Two temporary credits cover serial candidate, registration-target and candidate-recheck walks. Admission/finalization/freeze share one gate; late resource errors latch the surviving cohort, and worker-only cleanup retains uncertain/blocked ownership across provider restart. Independently selected empirical evidence requires complete applicable owned/hooks and native-call envelopes plus independent real listener/store/action outcomes; opaque acquisitions/peaks/internal errors remain unproved. Serviceability instrument/subject construction is specified; path producers/reviews precede mandatory whole-resource review/planning and execution remains pending. Wrong witnesses, observed resource errors/backoff, lost applicable events and inconclusive controls cannot pass. Native prompt/useful-launch/home-omissions/compatibility acceptance stays pending.

diagrams.title: Reuse two temporaries before finalization
diagrams.caption: Marks missing replay/bracket/final-membership phases; no third descriptor or uncharged reacquisition is inferred. Phase flow, not an atomic snapshot or model-checked state machine. Root streams keep separate credits. Capture candidate values and close its temporaries before checking one registration/preferred URL at a time; release native result owners and reacquire the original candidate before committing bounded values and diagnostics together. Observed change follows the spec scope rules. Uncertain metadata may still finalize a reveal/copy candidate as UNKNOWN when path/identity are established; this view focuses on ownership rather than every value branch. Freeze/refusal discards uncommitted data; late acquisitions close only on the worker. Late resource errors latch before membership release, while ambiguous close retains refusal/Q until process restart. The check-to-call/ABA and opaque-allocation limits survive. Native ordering/prompt/serviceability subjects remain pending. Pre-open witness and replay/size-phase producer repairs/reviews precede long-path classification design/review, then complete-resource review/planning. Same-identity byte variants are not independent change; retained app spelling remains first-finalized.

diagrams.title: Observe one canonical path and diagnose native size refusals
diagrams.caption: Marks mount/symlink witnesses, replay composition and current/prefix size scopes as producer repairs; preserves resolver bounds and names. Selected design, not native acceptance. One component resolver at every length/source uses 32 link expansions, an 8193-byte readlink buffer, 8192-byte pending text and derived finite work. Native dot/dot-dot/mount/firmlink transitions and absolute restarts never use lexical deletion. Parent and no-follow child identities/known-policy lookups precede open; dialog/hydration acceptance remains required. fsgetpath reports cached spelling with default firmlink presentation, not a unique identity string. Fresh directory reports supply descendant prefixes; queued listed locations and earlier results remain observations. Retained app identities keep first finalized spelling. Same-identity byte differences alone prove no movement/failure; independent association/reopened expected identity can expose change, while first unassociated observations lack a detector. Full-buffer ENOSPC is size, not change. All file entry kinds retain representable 8192-byte locations; queued descent-size refusal uses VALUE_LIMIT SUBTREE without name withdrawal/truncation. Shared proof failure stops one root; target failures stay exact and links stay ENTRY. Witness and observation-phase repairs/reviews precede classification design/review, then complete-resource review/planning; native queue/classification/no-dialog/useful outcomes remain pending.

diagrams.title: Finish shallow names before bounded descent
diagrams.caption: Retains FIFO and listed tasks; marks current-turn replay and independently proved prefix-size continuation unresolved. Selected per-root FIFO design, not runtime acceptance. Before each listing turn, independently reacquire stored location with A/B while the stream holds its root credit, then use fresh reported spelling/policy before reads. Listed-location tasks retain expected target/parent identities, never an assumed child canonical join. Parent AND child checks precede opening; independent shared failure stops one root, final-target failure under stable parent stays exact. Native descent-size refuses descendants without withdrawing names; depth/package no-descent cases need no child canonicalization. Prefix walks/reacquisition repeat against the same wait and scratch, not entry credits. No byte-only movement inference. Worker-only cleanup retains stream/queue/credits. Witness and observation-phase repairs/reviews, classification design/review and complete-resource review precede planning. Useful native coverage and measured omissions remain unaccepted.

diagrams.title: Report every root and distinguish blocked scope from failure
diagrams.caption: Retains exact name-preserving queued size semantics; distinguishes genuine shared-proof failure from unresolved current/prefix size scope. Selected observation/coverage design, not runtime acceptance. Required witnesses are charged before turns; native witness errors refuse dependent roots while account overflow refuses the job. Protected/policy scopes remain explicit. Invalid/publicly unrepresentable names use actual-parent CHILD_GROUP; ordinary directory anchors stay matchable under depth/frontier/native descent limits. Known queued native descent ENOSPC under unchanged association is VALUE_LIMIT SUBTREE/null count with no name withdrawal or inferred truncation. Other target failures stay exact; shared proof failure stops one root. Outcome/no-progress precedence, lifecycle errors and compatible typed BLOCKED transport remain unchanged. Witness and observation-phase repairs/reviews precede classification design/review, then resource review/planning. No native or reduced workflow acceptance is supplied.

diagrams.title: Choose a location, then revalidate through existing actions
diagrams.caption: Discloses PATH_MAX-limited action inspection and launch/open design/review for long returned locations. Designed source-role/data handoff, not deployment containers or action acceptance. File listed locations and fresh reported descendant prefixes are distinct observations; native-only descent size preserves representable names. Retained app identities keep their first finalized reported spelling; no global stable-cache history or later-action identity binding is promised. Client query/chooser/MRU/clipboard remain client-owned, and selection uses the existing constrained actions and complete grants. Witness and observation-phase repairs/reviews precede classification design/review and resource review/planning. Native useful coverage, no-dialog behavior, compatibility and measured omissions remain pending. Long-location boundary analysis selects an unimplemented failure correction; a supported metadata/classification/submission route and review remain live. Earlier short-path acceptance supplies no long-location pass.

diagrams.title: Discover names without probing protected traversal
diagrams.caption: Bounded evidence, macOS 26.5/25F71 in a clean TestAnyware VM. Test-only workspace startup instrumentation ran inside the actual signed hardened Koine host with unchanged identity, Info.plist and empty entitlements. Ordinary directory listing, the home scan with exclusions and system-app inspection were prompt-free. Direct Desktop/Documents/Downloads listing and a Desktop Spotlight query prompted. Denial produced Cocoa 257 for listing but an apparently successful zero-result query. Disabled indexing still returned filenames, including from the test disk image. This recommends name enumeration with explicit skipped scope; it proves neither exhaustive discovery nor a race-free no-prompt guarantee. The API and new consent diagnostics remain the next design step.

diagrams.title: First-use metadata and default-handler prompt boundary
diagrams.caption: Measured macOS 26.5/25F71 on a Developer ID hardened GUI probe matching Koine’s empty entitlements and usage keys. Each case resets consent. Metadata and registered-app inspection did not prompt; file-URL handler lookup for text and alias documents did. A TextEdit URL after denial does not establish permission or safe inspection. Protected default opening remains pending a human consent/semantics decision. Removable/network volumes were unavailable. Other workspace operation acceptance remains pending.

diagrams.title: Launch or open, then capture desktop state
diagrams.caption: Designed sequence. All four mutations and their result fields require workspace:control AND desktop:control; neither read is implicit. Unconstrained selection allows running-copy reuse; a path constrains the installation. The receipt carries only optional observed PID/kernel start, for a separately authorized desktop read/focus. The three-second acknowledgment wait can end before Gatekeeper or launch completes, and the core deadline may answer first. An acknowledgment alone does not pass activation acceptance. Reveal returns Finder acknowledgment without a process. App reactions and process/file races remain acceptance limits. Long-location boundary analysis selects an unimplemented failure correction; a supported metadata/classification/submission route and review remain live. Earlier short-path acceptance supplies no long-location pass.

diagrams.title: Keep dependency absence before the submission boundary
diagrams.caption: Designed outcomes after whole-mutation preflight and live admission. Input, capability and inspection failures stay separate; no new OS consent is allocated. Dependency absence certifies only that this action submitted no domain request. After submission a timeout or failure is not a safe retry signal; late acknowledgment is ignored. Without errors at or below the result, AVAILABLE has a receipt and DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE has reason/guidance, never both. Publication errors may suppress the selected branch without changing a published status. Native acknowledgment does not prove browser content, activation or Finder selection. Long-location boundary analysis selects an unimplemented failure correction; a supported metadata/classification/submission route and review remain live. Earlier short-path acceptance supplies no long-location pass.

diagrams.title: Reserve identities and choose before loading
diagrams.caption: Designed startup calculation for each enabled shipped slot, deterministic for fixed verification verdicts. Approval also requires the catalogue's release signing identifier; fixtures use separate test identities. Reserved-only slots cannot load; unrelated claimants cannot evict an absent owner. A highest tie refuses that release group and repeats with remaining eligible copies, reaching the bundle if needed. Every refusal and missing bundle stays visible. Candidate-specific staging preserves quarantine provenance. Ordinary collisions and host/root failures are detailed in the spec. This view is not native verification.

diagrams.title: Keep selection frozen through publication and start
diagrams.caption: Designed lifecycle after selection. Principal conflicts between shipped selections refuse both without fallback; descriptor/schema rejection can leave images mapped but publishes no contribution and can remove authority dependents. Startup failure retains schema and capabilities. No frozen choice is retried. Core management survives provider failure; root/core startup failure can prevent listening. Acceptance uses a fresh host process per native scenario, public GraphQL, and assigned signed VM cases; all remain pending.

diagrams.title: Six providers and their authority boundaries
diagrams.caption: Proposed component composition, not separate deployment containers. Existing desktop grants expand to geometry, pointer and system media; workspace discovery/open, input and menus need distinct grants. All five new bundles use one native loader and the catalogue's release signing identities. Tool operations add any focus/input/menu authority their native effects require. The host association and interaction cleanup algorithms remain downstream design work.

diagrams.title: Capture input or menu targets without desktop control
diagrams.caption: Designed sequence for independently grantable application input or menu actions. Fresh discovery needs that provider's read grant; a previously obtained target can be used with control and a control-authorized receipt. Protected targets are refused again before effects. Bounded system Space switching is a separate operation requiring input and desktop control. References remain provider-local; this view proves no stronger native identity or menu validation.

diagrams.title: Check every effect before dispatching any action
diagrams.caption: Designed host behavior under additional-capabilities-v1. For example, workspace launch/open/reveal requires workspace:control AND desktop:control. Cleanup authority is fixed when an interaction is admitted. An unavailable dependency result certifies no effects by that action, not earlier actions. Protected/stale targets, permission refusal and ambiguous failures remain distinct. The feature needs a compatible framework minor and old/new binary acceptance.

diagrams.title: Resident application and client boundary
diagrams.caption: Runtime responsibility view: one resident Koine application contains the native UI, server and providers. Closing its management window leaves the listener and observation running. The native UI keeps management authority in process; HTTP clients present bearer credentials backed by live grants. Providers share that process and its OS permissions.

diagrams.title: Source packages and interface dependencies
diagrams.caption: Application/framework composition, shown as package dependencies rather than deployment containers. Koine supplies one shared provider framework image, Machine invokes its contracts, and separately built providers conform to them. Published Swift types and protocols carry the compatibility promise; GraphQL-library types remain private. The client owns its GraphQL adapter; no Koine-owned client helper is required.

diagrams.title: Discover windows, derive choices, focus one
diagrams.caption: Served API: query before choices and resolve an opaque reference before acting. Exact targeting is not established across actual PID reuse; see docs/specs/machine.md#native-targeting-discussion. Capability denial and missing Koine consent stay distinct; no automatic mutation replay.

diagrams.title: Authorize every action before executing any
diagrams.caption: Execution flow for an authenticated client operation. The core expands the selected GraphQL operation and checks original schema coordinates, so aliases and fragments do not rename authority. Any denied mutation action prevents all actions from beginning. Revocation is checked again at each dispatch admission. Earlier authorized effects are not rolled back if a later action fails. Enrollment and the in-process console have separately defined admission cases in the spec.

diagrams.title: Grant issuance, approval and revocation
diagrams.caption: Bearer-credential lifecycle and revocation ordering. Anonymous enrollment creates only a pending request. Existing managers or the in-process console approve requests or create manual grants. Approved grants survive restart without automatic expiry; pending-request expiry does not expire them. Secret possession permits own-request status before and after its decision; revoked grants fail authentication. Digest uniqueness prevents retries from creating multiple grants. Already admitted actions may finish. This diagram is not a model-checking result.

diagrams.title: Swift framework and the rejected alternative
diagrams.caption: Koine uses the shared resilient Swift framework. Swift types and protocols are part of its stable published contract, with library evolution and module stability enabled. Koine does not use the C-compatible alternative. Compatible provider binaries dynamically link the host-supplied framework; newer required symbols need a newer host and are checked before loading.

diagrams.title: Native schema and resolver contributions
diagrams.caption: The shared Swift framework as the loader applies it. Verify signed manifests and required framework versions before loading, then resolve the named principal class and require ProviderFactory conformance. Validate schema and authority metadata before starting the Provider. Requests/results use owned Swift values and async protocol methods. Independently built old/new binaries are verified through the native plugin seam (docs/verification/binary-compatibility.md); native trust is distinct from client capabilities.

diagrams.title: Separate long-location lookup, classification and submission
diagrams.caption: Reviewed boundary repair, not a supported complete route or native acceptance. Search supplies up to 8192 UTF-8 bytes. Distinguish source/expanded text, native facts, file-URL handler lookup, registered app spelling and receipt executable identity. Established cycles/impossible components remain PATH_NOT_FOUND; completed native nil facts retain their accepted meanings. Unresolved link budgets, whole/expanded size refusal and unacquired facts mean pre-submission failed. Explicit dependency and payload-refusal branches submit nothing. Independent roughly 1500-byte action fixtures belong to launch-and-open; actual-search handoff belongs to later search acceptance. Positive long-path observer controls, short-workflow regressions with long registered copies and separate 1.0.0/1.0.1/1.1.0 profiles remain pending. Final route review precedes consumers. No shortened/copy-only baseline, systematic null receipt loss, new consent or private policy is accepted.
